subject: Cloud Computing
title: Satya Nadella's Cloud Bet
description: A fast breakdown of Satya Nadella's Cloud Bet for builders.

hook.text: When Satya Nadella became Microsoft CEO in 2014, he said three words: 'mobile first, cloud first.'

buildup.text: He shifted Microsoft from selling Windows licenses to selling cloud subscriptions. Wall Street panicked.

discovery.text: Nadella embraced Linux, open source, and even competitors — heresy under previous leadership.

twist.text: The bet worked. Microsoft's market cap tripled in five years. Azure revenue grew over 50% annually.

climax.text: Nadella transformed Microsoft from a declining software company into a cloud-first powerhouse.

punchline.text: Nadella bet Microsoft's future on cloud. The gamble paid off enormously.

quiz.question: What was radical about Satya Nadella's strategy for Microsoft?
options: He shifted from selling software licenses to cloud subscriptions and embraced open source
He shut down Windows to focus entirely on hardware
He merged Microsoft with Amazon to create a combined cloud

details.summary: When Satya Nadella became Microsoft CEO in 2014, he pivoted the company from Windows-first to cloud-first. This transformation turned Azure from an afterthought into the second-largest cloud platform and more than tripled Microsoft's market cap to over $3 trillion.
details.whyItMatters: Nadella's cloud bet is one of the most successful corporate transformations in history. It demonstrated that even established technology giants can pivot to compete in new markets.
takeaways: Nadella pivoted Microsoft from Windows-first to cloud-first
Azure grew from a minor product to the second-largest cloud
Microsoft's market cap tripled to over $3 trillion

faq.question: What did Nadella change at Microsoft?
faq.answer: Nadella shifted Microsoft's culture from an internal Windows-centric focus to a cloud and AI strategy. He embraced open source, made Office available on competitors' platforms, acquired GitHub and LinkedIn, and invested heavily in Azure and AI, fundamentally transforming the company.

faq.question: How did Azure catch up to AWS?
faq.answer: Azure leveraged Microsoft's existing enterprise relationships, bundled cloud with Office 365 enterprise agreements, offered hybrid solutions connecting to on-premises Windows infrastructure, and invested heavily in AI partnerships including a major OpenAI investment.
